title: Valid Payment Systems Product Codes
applicability: Applies to Product Code Element 77 in Segment 102 when Segment 100 transaction context requires product/fuel data.

classificationFormatEvidence.scope: Source classification and transaction field format only; no transaction eligibility, full Segment 102, converter or SME certification.

businessRequirements.title: Each Product Code Segment 102 product shall use a valid Appendix F Product Code.
Product Code 000 shall not be used as a product because Appendix F identifies it as unused.
Each type of fuel purchase shall use a unique Product Code.
Fuel products shall precede nonfuel products, and EV fuel product data shall be first where applicable.
Product amounts shall reconcile to Segment 100 fuel, nonfuel, tax, and cash totals.

testCases.positive: Unique fuel codes with fuel products first
